scope: All commits reachable through local Git refs at execution; unique eligible blobs inspected only in memory using the current working-tree compliance checker patterns, suffix/directory exclusions and placeholder rules.
limitations: No reflogs, unreachable objects, remote-only commits or other repositories scanned.
No historical code executed; only the current checker was imported.
No FusionAuth API-key investigation, identification or credential selection performed.
No matched values, lines, fragments, secret-derived hashes or fingerprints emitted or persisted.
No individual finding locations or content retained in evidence.
High-signal pattern scan only; excluded file types/directories and unrecognized secret formats are outside coverage.
UTF-8 decoding ignores invalid bytes, matching the current checker behavior.
Counts reflect matches per pattern per line in unique eligible blobs, not unique credentials.
Local refs may be stale; this does not verify remote synchronization, GitHub alerts, credential validity or absence of all secrets.
